Name: Abdi, Son of Malluch
Summary: Son of Malluch and father of Kishi in Ethan's line.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 6:44: Son of Malluch and father of Kishi in Ethan's line.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Abdi stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
